Introduction.en: Infernos swirl up devastating fire tornados that sweep zombies back, burning and damaging them.

Chat.en: Inferno doesn't feel like he gets enough credit. "Of course I burn zombies," he fumes. "That's a given. But what about how I sweep them down the lane through the sheer force of hot air? Where's my prize for that?"

BriefIntroduction.en: Burns and pushes zombies back

Introduction.en: Zoybean Pods grow from sprouts to full pods, then split open to release helpful plant "zomboids" which attack zombies.

Chat.en: "Developing plant zomboids in eerie mimicry of zombie life is well within the boundaries of human experience," Zoybean Pod insists with a calm, unvarying steadiness.

BriefIntroduction.en: Grows helpful zomboids

Introduction.en: Ice Blooms freeze, chill, and damage all zombies on the board, and more so in a 3x3 area around where they're planted.

DESCRIPTION.en: turns several of the most dangerous zombies into ice sculptures, obstructing other zombies

Chat.en: "The last time Ice Bloom had pancakes for breakfast, she wasn't satisfied. She can't say why, exactly, but there was something subtly wrong with them. The shocking reason? Substandard maple syrup."

BriefIntroduction.en: Freezes and damages zombies, turning some of which into ice sculptures

Introduction.en: Gold Blooms produce a burst of sun all at once.

Chat.en: "Your botanists were so preoccupied with whether they could," says Gold Bloom, about nothing and to nobody in particular, "they didn't stop to think if they should."

BriefIntroduction.en: Produces a burst of sun all at once

Introduction.en: Twin Sunflowers give twice as much sun as a normal sunflower.

Chat.en: Twin Sunflower's super-chic line of ultra-expensive sunglasses has been a huge hit wherever she goes. Due to this she has been unable to travel without being swarmed by the Poppyrazzi.

BriefIntroduction.en: Gives twice as much as a sunflower

Introduction.en: Sun-shrooms give small suns at first, then normal suns, and finally large suns.

Chat.en: Oh sure, Sun-shroom is known for his ever-present grin and sunny disposition. But truth be told, even he has his dark days. It ain't easy keeping things light when you live in the shadow.

BriefIntroduction.en: Gives more sun over time

Introduction.en: Lily Pads let you plant non-aquatic plants on top of them.

DESCRIPTION.en: can also be planted under non-aquatic plants

Chat.en: Not many people know this, but Lily Pad absolutely loves square dancing. There he is, a circular plant gliding across the dance floor making squares. He loves how it pushes his boundaries and really makes him outside the sphere.

BriefIntroduction.en: Let you plant non-aquatic plants on top of it

Introduction.en: Shooting Starfruits shoot stars in 5 lanes.

Chat.en: When you see a Shooting Starfruit, make a wish, any wish! Any wish that involves takin' down Zombies, that is.

BriefIntroduction.en: Shoots 5 stars along the lanes at a time

Introduction.en: Starfruits shoot stars in 5 directions.

Chat.en: Just a small town fruit that travelled to the big city and found his way to the future. His favorite modes of transportation: conveyor belts, hoverboards, and rockets. WEEEEE!

BriefIntroduction.en: Shoots stars in 5 directions

Introduction.en: Angel Starfruits adjust the angles and then shoot stars in 5 directions.

DESCRIPTION.en: changes shooting directions according to zombies' coordinates

Chat.en: Princess Angel Starfruit is far more energetic than Starfruit from a small town. Starfruit can't even be bothered to rotate himself a little.

BriefIntroduction.en: Adjusts the angle and shoots stars in 5 directions

Introduction.en: Homing Thistles fire seeking shots at targets that are the closest to home.

Chat.en: Don't even think about trying to pull one over on Homing Thistle. He's got a bead on you. He sees right through your facade. It's like he has a laser beam... aimed at your soul.

BriefIntroduction.en: Attacks farthest left target in any lane

Introduction.en: Rotobagas shoot projectiles along the four diagonals, in each direction that has a target.

Chat.en: Sometimes Rotobaga hears the other plants gossiping about each other. "Did you notice that so-and-so has been putting on weight?" they might say. Or, "I hear that so-and-so is dating so-and-so. Can you believe it?" But Rotobaga isn't the kind of plant to engage in idle gossiping. She's not interested in talking about anyone behind their leaves. She does her best to rise above it.

BriefIntroduction.en: Shoots along the diagonal, up to four directions at a time

Introduction.en: Primal Peashooters shoot heavy peas with a brief stun at zombies.

DESCRIPTION.en: primal peas occasionally knock zombies back

Chat.en: Primal Peashooter may be primitive, but that doesn't stop him from enrolling and excelling in several software development correspondence courses.

BriefIntroduction.en: Shoots heavy stunning peas

Introduction.en: Sling Peas fire 5 peas in a burst, targeting the zombies closest to your house each time.

Chat.en: Sling Pea keeps a keen eye on the whole battle space. He's alert and attentive. "If something slips through," he muses quietly, "it would be my fault. And I just couldn't forgive myself if that happened."

BriefIntroduction.en: Fires 5 peas at whole board

Introduction.en: Dark Matter Dragonfruits are shadow plants that damage zombies with dark energies. Make zombies heavier and slower when powered by other Shadow plants.

DESCRIPTION.en: zombies caught in the dark energy explosion will take higher damage than those who directly contact his projectiles
when powered, the more healthy zombies are, the heavier they'll become
heavy zombies' movements become slower and will be harder to knockback

Chat.en: Dark Matter Dragonfruit's ancestors were hunted to the depths of space. Now their descendants are back for cold, fruity vengeance.

BriefIntroduction.en: Launches explosive dark energies

Introduction.en: Asparajets shoot at zombies in three lanes.

DESCRIPTION.en: must reload for a moment when finishing 7 shots

Chat.en: Asparagus enjoys the reputation of being the "King of Vegetables", yet Asparajet takes no pride in this. Having loved studying all kinds of firearms since childhood, he can only realize its value on the battlefield. "I just want everyone to remember the passionate me on the battlefield!" Asparagus said earnestly.

BriefIntroduction.en: Shoots at zombies in three lanes

Introduction.en: Threepeaters shoot peas in three lanes.

Chat.en: Threepeater loves playing multiplayer in video games, but split-screen never works out because the left head always cheats.

BriefIntroduction.en: Shoots three peas in three lanes

Introduction.en: Fire Peashooters shoot flaming peas down the lane.

Chat.en: Fire Peashooter knows that what she does looks exciting. But working with an open flame is serious and, more importantly, dangerous business. That's why, in her spare time, she talks to children about the importance of fire safety. "I'm a trained professional," she explains. "Don't try this at home, kids."

BriefIntroduction.en: Shoots flaming peas and warms nearby plants

Introduction.en: Floawer Pots let you plant un-flyable plants on top of them.

DESCRIPTION.en: carries plants that aren't able to fly
click on it to move between different places without carrying any plants

Chat.en: Floawer Pot is actually from the future for sure, but not from your roof in the past. "You asked why? Feed me a Plant Food, I'd tell ya! " He says.

BriefIntroduction.en: Allows un-flyable plants to be planted in sky

Introduction.en: Pea Vines planted on top of Appease-mint Family plants provide a significant damage boost to those plants.

Chat.en: Pea Vine boosts Appease-mint Family plants, and he himself is an Appease-mint Family plant, so therefore... hang on... don't tell me... I can do this. I said DON'T TELL ME.

BriefIntroduction.en: Boosts Appease-mint plants

Introduction.en: Pumpkins can be planted on top of other plants to provide a tough additional layer of armor.

Chat.en: Pumpkin may be a hollowed-out shell, but he still has a rich inner life filled with feelings, fantasies and suprisingly disappointing opinions.

BriefIntroduction.en: Surrounds and protects

Introduction.en: Grave Busters consume graves they're planted on.

DESCRIPTION.en: single use, must be planted on graves

Chat.en: He may appear spiky or ill-tempered, but Grave Buster just wants to give you a big hug. Unless you're a puppy. He's terrified of those.

BriefIntroduction.en: Plant it on a grave to remove the grave

Introduction.en: Fume-shrooms shoot fumes that damage all zombies in an area.

Chat.en: "I think of myself as a pretty confident shroom and an all-around fungi,"says Fume-shroom."But sometimes, when I'm eating Plant Food, I hear them chuckling. I hear them calling me 'Balloon-shroom'. I don't think they know how much that hurts."

BriefIntroduction.en: Shoots fumes that can damage all zombies in an area

Introduction.en: A timid mushroom that shoots spore projectiles at zombies in its lane, but hides when they get too close.

DESCRIPTION.en: stops attacking when zombies appears around

Chat.en: "How did I get talked into this? I wish I was at home."

BriefIntroduction.en: Shoots spore projectiles at the zombies, but hides when they get too close

Introduction.en: Mega Gatling Peas fire 4 peas at one time.

DESCRIPTION.en: upgrades to 5x firing speed if Plant Fooded
has chance to randomly Plant Food himself

Chat.en: "I used to be an upgrade," says Mega Gatling Pea with uncharacteristic shyness."Now I'm my own plant, with my own ambitions, dreams and gym club memberships!"

BriefIntroduction.en: Fire 4 peas at a time

Introduction.en: Repeaters fire two peas at one time.

Chat.en: "Everyone always askes me if we've met before," says Repeater."Everyone always asks me if we've met before. Wait, did I just say that?"

BriefIntroduction.en: Shoots two peas at the enemy

Introduction.en: Bonk Choys rapidly punch nearby enemies that are ahead or behind them.

Chat.en: A freelance dentist on the side, he's offering a special this month - he'll knock two of your teeth out of the price of one!

BriefIntroduction.en: Rapidly punches enemies ahead or behind

Introduction.en: Wasabi Whips lash out with their flaming whips, delivering whippings to zombies both in front and behind.

DESCRIPTION.en: resist cold and warms nearby plants

Chat.en: "The trick to proper whipping is all in the wrist," says Wasabi Whip. "Well, not the wrist, exactly, since I don't have any. You have to, like... BE the wrist."

BriefIntroduction.en: Whips both ahead and behind

Introduction.en: Iceberg Lettuces freezes a zombie when stepped on.

Chat.en: Don't get lost staring into Iceberg's adorably cute eyes. If you do, it will be your last step... but only if you're a zombie.

BriefIntroduction.en: Freezes zombies that step on it, and extinguishes flames

Introduction.en: Bloomerangs can hit multiple targets in their lane, twice each coming and going!

Chat.en: As the first new member to your home defence team, Bloomerang enjoys long walkabouts with his friends, Koala Bear, and listening to his Bob Barley albums out back.

BriefIntroduction.en: Hits up to three targets in its lane, twice

Introduction.en: Bambooshoots dig back and forth on the ground, damaging zombies that step on them.

Chat.en: Bambooshoot learned Earth Traversal from Tu Xingsun. After years of grinding (literally), he got his "Underground Degree" in Tunnel Engineering.

BriefIntroduction.en: Digs back and forth and damages zombies that step on them

Introduction.en: Cabbage-pults hurl cabbages at the enemy.

Chat.en: Cabbage-pult received his doctorate in pulting from Harvest University. He knows a thing or two about launching hit way to the top. He also makes a mean soup.

BriefIntroduction.en: Hurls cabbages over obstacles at the enemy

Introduction.en: Blooming Hearts lob projectiles that infatuate zombies, causing their defences reduced.

Chat.en: Blooming Heart loves zombies. She gets guff from her fellow plants over it, but she stands firm. She's into zombies and makes no apologies about it.

BriefIntroduction.en: Lobs projectiles that infatuate zombies, causing their defences reduced

Introduction.en: Shrinking Violets shrinks zombies in an area, forcing them to take double damage and reducing the bite damage they inflict.

Chat.en: Shrinking Violet started out shy, but it's remarkable how a discovering a magical talent for zombie-reduction can change your whole outlook.

BriefIntroduction.en: Shrinks zombies and makes them weaker

Introduction.en: Solar Sages illuminate zombies, causing them to make better choices and depart, leaving behind a trail of sun.

Chat.en: "Ommm," Solar Sage hums softly to herself. But she's not kidding anybody. We all know her mind is filled with race cars and bulldozers.

BriefIntroduction.en: Illuminates zombies for sun

Introduction.en: Lychees damage zombies in an area around it when attacked.

DESCRIPTION.en: damages all zombies in a 3x3 area when attacked

Chat.en: Lychee knows gratitude, but bears any of his enemies a grudge. He always keep those in mind, "Tit for tat is fair play. Receive drips of water when in need, and return the kindness with a spring."

BriefIntroduction.en: Hurts zombies in an area when attacked

Introduction.en: Atomic Bombegranates explode on contact, dealing heavy damages in a huge area and spawning Seedlings around them.

DESCRIPTION.en: Seedlings around will grow up into new bombegranates

Chat.en: Remember: Never ever EVER split a fruit. Oh, hold on, actually fruits are ok, just never split an atom.

BriefIntroduction.en: Explodes on contact, spawning Seedlings around

Introduction.en: Potato Mines explode on contact, but they take time to arm. Plant them ahead of zombies.

Chat.en: Believe it or not, SPUDOW! did not happen overnight. Having been forced to try out new catchphrases and focus testing as many variation as possible (Tubular? Really?), Potato Mine weeded out the competition to stick with what he knows best.

BriefIntroduction.en: Explodes on contact, but takes time to arm itself

Introduction.en: Peashooters are your first line of defence. They shoot peas at attacking zombies.

Chat.en: "What is it like being famous?"asked Peashooter while sipping his bottled water,"I can't talk right now, I'm finishing my merchandising deal. Hold my fir coat."

BriefIntroduction.en: Shoots peas at the enemies

Introduction.en: Goo Peashooters shoot poison peas at zombies, poisoning them as well as slowing them down.

Chat.en: Goo Peashooter is a goopy shooter. See? See how that works? It's a play on words. Words are often playful, folks!

BriefIntroduction.en: Shoots sticky poison peas

Introduction.en: Snap Peas dive underground, burrow towards zombies, then pop up underneath to swallow them in one gulp. Snap Peas then return to their starting spot, chew on the entire matter for a while, and finally spit the zombies' heads out at attackers.

Chat.en: "I'm a picky eater, I'll admit it," admits Snap Pea casually. "I'll eat a zombie, no problem, but there's just something about heads. I feel like they're looking at me."

BriefIntroduction.en: Eats zombies and spits out their heads

Introduction.en: Shadow Peashooters are shadow plants that fire piercing shadowy peas at zombies.

DESCRIPTION.en: fires piercing, slowing bolts when powered
hides and swallows zombies that approach

Chat.en: "Phoot, " Shadow Peashooter says, emitting a shadowy, ah, hmmm, I guess you could call it a pea, at a distant zombie. "Uph!" gasps the zombie in the evident surprise. There's a lot going on under the surface between these two.

BriefIntroduction.en: Fires piercing slowing bolts

Introduction.en: Seashooters are amphibious and shoot in three directions while staying in water.

Chat.en: While helping her niece in school, Dave accidentally left Peashooters on a Lilypad near the school's pool. Four years later, Dave returned to his niece's graduation and found it had mutated into a totally different plant. "No beach pass? No entry!" says Seashooter while personally throwing zombies out of the water. "H2-OH-NO you don't!" exclaims Seashooter to the zombies entering the lawn or the pool on its watch.

BriefIntroduction.en: Amphibious plant that shoots 3 peas at the enemies

Introduction.en: Sunflowers are essential for you to produce extra sun. Try planting as many as you can!

Chat.en: After the release of her first major YouTuber video "Zombies On Your Lawn", Sunflower's YouTube channel has been bursting with fun. She is currently putting the final touches on her reality show TV pitch "Sunflower Thinks She Can Dance".

BriefIntroduction.en: Gives you additional sun

Introduction.en: Shine Vines are vine plants that amplify the sun production of sun producer plants, except Moonflower, create some sun on their own, and use a sun-stun burst as a last second defense when attacked.

DESCRIPTION.en: best used on sun producer plants

Chat.en: "Peek-a-boo!" giggles Shine Vine, staring directly at you, the player. "Consider that fourth wall SHATTERED!"

BriefIntroduction.en: Increases sun production

Introduction.en: Primal Sunflowers pop out large suns instead of regular ones.

Chat.en: Primal Sunflower is new to all this sun-giving business, so be patient with her. She's an early adopter of the all-you-can-stuff-yourself buffet style of sun production.

BriefIntroduction.en: Gives large suns

Introduction.en: Wall-nuts have hard shells which you can use to protect your other plants.

Chat.en: Having retired from his days as a champion bowler in the Pro Leagues, Wall-nut is looking forward to a real challenge on the front lines of home defence. DEFENCE! DEFENCE!

BriefIntroduction.en: Blocks off zombies and protects your other plants

Introduction.en: Mirror-nuts collects energies from other nuts when they're damaged. Click to release the energies.

DESCRIPTION.en: when charged and defeated, deals damage to all enemies in the lane

Chat.en: Mirror-nut dressed up as a mirrorball for a disco-themed party. He never looked back, because that'd get his view blocked by his own outfit.

BriefIntroduction.en: Tap on the nut to fire energies collected from damaged nuts

Introduction.en: Spinapples block off zombies, and spin to reflect hostile projectiles.

DESCRIPTION.en: attracts projectiles when on being fed with Plantfood

Chat.en: Others often question the way Spinapple deals with his problems, "Is it because of the elasticity of your body rather than your spinning that make the bullets reflected?" He replied about that, "I just like spinning, which relaxes my spinning leaves."

BriefIntroduction.en: Blocks off zombies and reflect projectiles

Introduction.en: Murkadamia Nuts are defensive shadow plants who, when powered, grow jelly murk to damage attacking zombies.

Chat.en: "Some say that encasing yourself in gelatin is no way to conduct an offense, " says Murkadamia Nut with an infectious twinkle. "I say they just haven't planted ME yet!"

BriefIntroduction.en: Powered murk damages zombies

Introduction.en: Dragon Bruits launch 3 explosive seed pod projectiles at zombies across 3 adjacent lanes. When destroyed, Dragon Bruits will split into 3 smaller plants.

DESCRIPTION.en: powered Dragon Bruits apply poison to the projectiles

Chat.en: While each head of Dragon Bruit doesn't have their own name, they do each have their own unique personality. The Center head is the calm, rational one. While Lefty is a bit reserved and shy. Righty is... Well... always right.

BriefIntroduction.en: Launches 3 explosive seed pod projectiles at zombies across 3 adjacent lanes

Introduction.en: Moonflowers radiate a glow that powers up adjacent shadow plant.

DESCRIPTION.en: emits sun as well as additional sun for each adjacent shadow plant up to four

Chat.en: Moonflower is a fierce collaborator. She'll collaborate with anything. She'd collaborate with a table if she could.

BriefIntroduction.en: Gives suns and powers up adjacent shadow plants

Introduction.en: Grimroses are shadow plants that behave like landbound Tangle Kelps, dragging up to 3 zombies into the dirt.

DESCRIPTION.en: powered Grimroses can drag 3 zombies before expiring

Chat.en: "When you think about it, the proper place for a zombie is in the ground," says Grimrose. "So, really, I'm just expediting the process."

BriefIntroduction.en: Drags zombies into the ground

Introduction.en: Nightshades are shadow plants that smack zombies with slappy leaves. Hurls and regrow its leaves when powered by other Shadow plants.

DESCRIPTION.en: hurls and regrows leaves when powered

Chat.en: For Nightshade, smacking is a duty and a privilege. He comes from a long line of ardent smackers, and his family counts three kings, four ambassadors and a president as among those proudly slapped around.

BriefIntroduction.en: Smacks zombies with slappy leaves

Introduction.en: Dusk Lobbers are shadow plants that lob explosive buds down the lane. When powered Dusk Lobbers can lob buds down three lane.

DESCRIPTION.en: lob buds down 3 lanes when powered

Chat.en: Lobbing comes easily for Dusk Lobber, but that's only because she's had extensive training and really enjoys parabolas.

BriefIntroduction.en: Lobs explosive buds

Introduction.en: Snow Peas fire frozen peas making it hard for zombies to advance.

DESCRIPTION.en: chills and damages zombie on impact

Chat.en: As a professional table tennis player, in the off-season he also enjoys skiing, playing the bongos, and spelunking.

BriefIntroduction.en: Shoots frozen peas that damage and slow zombies

Introduction.en: Lightning Reeds shoot lightning at the nearest zombie up to one lane away. The bolt will then arc and hit other zombies.

Chat.en: This may come as a shock, but Lightning Reed has a serious passion for ham radio. His call sign is El3ctric H1ccup. You can tune in every Tuesday to hear him read the classics to elderly plants. This week: Seeds and Sensibility.

BriefIntroduction.en: Zaps several chickens or zombies per strike

Introduction.en: Witch Hazels use magical sorcery to transform zombies into Puff-shrooms.

Chat.en: Witch Hazel paused, unsure how to proceed. Then all at once, she knew: Use magic, like, ALL THE TIME!

BriefIntroduction.en: Transforms zombies into Puff-shrooms

Introduction.en: Ampereums fire lightning bolts at zombies and absorb electric charges from surrounding plants.

DESCRIPTION.en: lightning bolts fired after absorbing charges deal much more damages

Chat.en: Just staying together is an ordeal for the Ampereum brothers. They must resist a powerful attraction to prevent their dangerous electrical energy from canceling out the instant they touch.

BriefIntroduction.en: Fire lightning bolts and absorb electric charges

Introduction.en: Kernel-pults fling corn kernels and butter at zombies.

Chat.en: While working as an usher at the local movieplex, he saw "Fried Green Tomatoes" and found his higher calling. He packed up his husks, his kernels, his butter, and enlisted.

BriefIntroduction.en: Flings corn kernels and butter at zombies

Introduction.en: Snowdrops throw chilly snow balls and freezy icicles at zombies.

Chat.en: Zombies are always looking at her with a frozen expression.

BriefIntroduction.en: Throw snow balls and icicles at zombies

Introduction.en: Meteor Flower conjures meteor strikes from the sky that leave molten tiles.

DESCRIPTION.en: meteors scare dinosaurs, forcing them to escape

Chat.en: "Out of this world molten mayhem! But first... coffee!!"

BriefIntroduction.en: Conjures meteor strikes from the sky that leaves molten tiles

Introduction.en: Spring Beans bounce back zombies that get too close. Will bounce them into water if nearby.

DESCRIPTION.en: pushes zombies back, or into water

Chat.en: He's the strong, silent type and little is known about Spring Bean. What is known though: his fan club is a million followers strong. And the ladies love him.

BriefIntroduction.en: Bounces zombies back and into nearby water

Introduction.en: Umbrella Leaves protect plants from falling threats.

DESCRIPTION.en: pushes zombies fell from sky to the right

Chat.en: She's not very frond of getting wet.

BriefIntroduction.en: Protects plants from falling threats

Introduction.en: Melon-pults do heavy damage to groups of zombies.

Chat.en: "Everyone says my head looks like a melon," said the middle child of the Pult-family, "and they would be right." Don't ask him if he's seedless or not though, it offends him and frankly it's none of your business.

BriefIntroduction.en: Does heavy damage to groups of zombies

Introduction.en: Cantaloupe-pults heavily damages groups of zombies without smashing them.

Chat.en: As one of the most heat-relieving fruits, Cantaloupe-pult hates those who claimed him to cause "inner heat". He directs this fury towards zombies and they hardly survive from this.

BriefIntroduction.en: Heavily damages groups of zombies without smashing them

Introduction.en: Winter Melons do heavy damage and slow to groups of zombies.

Chat.en: You may recognize Winter Melon's voice from such incredible documentaries as "It's Cold Up Here","Ice Bingo", and "Surfin' Swedes".

BriefIntroduction.en: Does heavy damage and slows groups of zombies

Introduction.en: Blovers blow away all zombies in the air.

Chat.en: The luckiest stunt clover around, Blover is the most recent recipient of the Stunty Award. You can see his work in "Bulb Fiction," "Rooty", and "Finding Flower". He also teaches stunt class on Tuesdays at the community center.

BriefIntroduction.en: Blows away all flying and floating zombies

Introduction.en: Spikeweeds destroy one rolling zombie and hurt any zombies that step on them.

Chat.en: Although Spikeweed grew up on the seedy side of town, his acupuncture business has been blooming.

BriefIntroduction.en: Breaks 1 rolling object, hurts zombies that step on it

Introduction.en: Iceweeds damage and chill zombies that walk over them.

DESCRIPTION.en: can take three hits from rolling zombies when fed with Plantfood

Chat.en: Iceweed is excited to get the call-up to the big leagues and can't wait to start refrigerating zombies whilst inflicting damage on them. He insisted we say "whilst."

BriefIntroduction.en: Hurts and chills zombies that step on it

Introduction.en: Spikerocks destroy multiple rolling zombies and damage zombies that walk over them.

DESCRIPTION.en: can take three hits from rolling zombies

Chat.en: Being the most metal plant, Spikerock has decided to hold his ultimate metal plant concert at Madison Rock Garden. Tickets have been sold out for many harvests.

BriefIntroduction.en: Breaks 3 rolling object, hurts zombies that step on it

Introduction.en: Chompers can devour 2 zombies whole, but they are vulnerable while chewing.

Chat.en: Everyone appreciates what Chomper does. His appetite has saved them on numerous occasions. But truth be told, Chomper's friends think that eating zombies is gross. And his breath! No one has the heart to tell him, and he never gets the hint when you offer him a mint.

BriefIntroduction.en: Devours zombies, then chews on each for a while

Introduction.en: Click on Ice-shrooms to freeze and chill all zombies on the lawn.

DESCRIPTION.en: tap to freeze all zombies on the lawn
emits cold mists that chill zombies
buffs nearby Winter-mint plants and freezes attacking zombies if Plant Fooded

Chat.en: His coldness can make even flames feel chilly; his gaze is like an icicle in winter, just one look can make you feel the bone-chilling coldness. If you ask him to tell a joke, even the air might freeze. That's why he's popular during summer.

BriefIntroduction.en: Tap to freeze all zombies

Introduction.en: Primal Wall-nuts cost a bit more than typical Wall-nuts, but they can be planted much more quickly.

Chat.en: "Grunt," explains Primal Wall-nut. "Grunt oog grunt-grunt," he goes on to say. "Ook-urg grunty grunt grunt," he concludes. A nut of many opinions, is Primal Wall-nut.

BriefIntroduction.en: Quick-planting wall that blocks off zombies

Introduction.en: Buttercup butters butter onto attacking zombies, stunning them with butter. Butter!

Chat.en: Buttercup's sweet as can be, but she packs a wallop! "I'm not cheap," she says, referring to her flat 25 sun cost. "I'm reasonable."

BriefIntroduction.en: Butters attacking zombies

Introduction.en: Banana Launchers can fire explosive bananas at any tile on the lawn.

DESCRIPTION.en: tap to arm, tap on target tile to fire
on impact, explodes in small area

Chat.en: It's important to avoid stereotyping as much as possible. Stereotypes are often flat-out wrong. And also hurtful. But honestly ... Banana Launcher is TOTALLY bananas.

BriefIntroduction.en: Click on banana, then a tile, to launch explosive banana

Introduction.en: Bamboozles can fire 5 bamboo sticks at most.

DESCRIPTION.en: tap to arm, tap on target tile to fire
bamboo sticks turn into bamboo buskets when hitting the floor

Chat.en: Only when confronting those skilled kongfu plants could you be defeated by a single straw.

BriefIntroduction.en: Click on bamboo, then a tile, to launch bamboo sticks

Introduction.en: Gumnuts pop sticky gum onto zombies, pinning them in place and causing them to block other zombies behind them.

DESCRIPTION.en: best used against Gargantuars & Football Mechs

Chat.en: "I only chew ham-flavored gum," exudes Gumnut. "Ham and salt."

BriefIntroduction.en: Creates gum barriers

Introduction.en: Aloes heal injured plants to their immediate right, keeping them healthy as possible.

Chat.en: Aloe likes to soothe. He likes to alleviate, he likes to restore, he likes to mend. But don't ask him to revive. He's touchy about revival.

BriefIntroduction.en: Heals rightward plants

Introduction.en: Holly Knight deals damage to zombies attacking him, and can launch 3 prickly barrier leaves to knock back and damage zombies.

DESCRIPTION.en: tap to arm, tap on target tile to fire
projectiles become prickly barriers when hitting the floor

Chat.en: Holly Knight would like to advise folks not to eat his berries. "It's rude to eat somebody's berries without asking," he says. "In addition, they are highly toxic."

BriefIntroduction.en: Damages attacking zombies, tap to launch barriers

Introduction.en: Missile Toes launch cold blasts that damage, chill and slow zombies.

DESCRIPTION.en: tap to arm, tap on target tile to fire
on impact, explodes in small area

Chat.en: While she is called Missile Toe, Missile Toe has no toes and, properly speaking, lacks missiles. How'd she get her name? Nepotism! Pure favoritism.

BriefIntroduction.en: Launches chilling blasts

Introduction.en: Cherry Bombs can blow up all zombies in an area. They have a short fuse so plant them near zombies.

Chat.en: The Cherry Bomb Brothers attempted to start their own band. "We tried to figure out what the sound would be, but we kept explodonating speakers, stages, fans, and of course, zombies. Look for our LP next year."

BriefIntroduction.en: Blows up all zombies in a medium area

Introduction.en: Loquanados rotate and drag zombies towards them in a medium range.

Chat.en: Loquanados, who dreams of becoming a ballet dancer, has a special talent to spin in place for countless rotations. "I know I could be the greatest ballet dancer in the world, but no one wants to hire me. I just don't get it," she said dejectedly, and took a big scoop of ice-cream.

BriefIntroduction.en: Drags zombies towards her in a medium area

Introduction.en: Noctarines are shadow plants that explode and create clouds of damaging and slowing gas.

DESCRIPTION.en: Noctarine gas can power shadow plants

Chat.en: For a plant churning with internal gases, Noctarine's opinions are shockingly conventional. "Jaws is a good movie, " he says. Like, NO KIDDING, Noctarine!

BriefIntroduction.en: Explodes to make gas cloud

Introduction.en: Reinforce-mints push all zombies back and provide a temporary boost to all Reinforce-mint Family plants on the lawn.

Chat.en: Reinforce-mint isn't scowling. He's just workshopping defense strategies, doing what he can to support the team. Maybe he's scowling just a little bit. Fine.

BriefIntroduction.en: Boosts defence plants

Introduction.en: Enlighten-mints give a burst of sun when planted, and provide an additional temporary boost to Enlighten-mint Family plants.

Chat.en: Enlighten-mint wants to stress that while "enlightenment" is properly understood as "full comprehension of a situation," she herself frequently likes to ask follow-up questions just to be sure.

BriefIntroduction.en: Boosts sun plants

Introduction.en: Winter-mints chill all zombies on the board when planted and provide a temporary boost to all Winter-mint Family plants on the lawn.

Chat.en: Winter-mint has advanced degrees in cryonics and cryogenics, is a master builder of snowmen, and subscribes to season passes at three different ski resorts. He does think it's a little chilly in here, though.

BriefIntroduction.en: Boosts cold plants

Introduction.en: Spear-mints generate a column of saws from the house and provide a temporary boost to all Spear-mint Family plants on the lawn.

Chat.en: "Slash!" Spear-mint enthuses. "Slishy-slashy-slice!" she adds, wanting to make sure she's getting her point across. She wants to be very clear on this.

BriefIntroduction.en: Boosts piercing plants

Introduction.en: Arma-mints launch a volley of heavy stunning artillery projectiles and provide a temporary boost to all Arma-mint Family plants on the lawn.

Chat.en: "Lobbing projectiles, for me, has always been a very personal endeavor," says Arma-mint. "It's a great way for me to express myself, my identity, and my preference that zombies can be defeated in large groups."

BriefIntroduction.en: Boosts cannon and lobbing plants

Introduction.en: Contain-mints stun all zombies on the board and provide a temporary boost to all Contain-mint Family plants on the lawn.

Chat.en: "Go easy, there," says Contain-mint. "No need to be in such a rush all the time. Movement is totally overrated."

BriefIntroduction.en: Boosts slowing plants

Introduction.en: Fila-mints do electric damage and provide a temporary boost to all Fila-mint Family plants on the lawn.

Chat.en: Fila-mint hovers enigmatically and electrically over the lawn, surveying his surroundings. He nods, once. It is good.

BriefIntroduction.en: Boosts electricity plants

Introduction.en: Appease-mints fire a volley of huge peas that break into smaller peas and provide a temporary boost to all Appease-mint Family plants on the lawn.

Chat.en: Appease-mint takes great umbrage at the notion that he might back down from a fight. "Yes, my name is 'Appease-mint,' but that has more to do with my affinity towards peas than any disinclination to stand up for my beliefs. Rescind your vile calumny this instant, lest I compose a blistering letter of outrage!"

BriefIntroduction.en: Boosts straight shooters

Introduction.en: Bombard-mints set off a number of explosions on the board and provide a temporary boost to all Bombard-mint Family plants on the lawn.

Chat.en: "Explosions are fun," says Bombard-mint with an impish twinkle in her eye. "In the context of eliminating zombies, a cascade of detonations not only clears much of the board, but leaves a lovely fragrance in its wake. It smells like... victory."

BriefIntroduction.en: Boosts explosive plants

Introduction.en: Enforce-mints shrink a number of zombies when planted and provide a temporary boost to all Enforce-mint Family plants on the lawn.

Chat.en: Enforce-mint shrinks zombies, which may seem a bit off-brand for a guy who's all about melee damage. Enforce-mint shrugs. "I don't set policy。" he says.

BriefIntroduction.en: Boosts melee plants

Introduction.en: Conceal-mints power up all shadow plants on the lawn, drag some number of zombies to their doom, and provide an additional temporary boost to Conceal-mint Family plants.

Chat.en: Conceal-mint ducks ninja-like out of the party without telling a soul. "Where's Conceal-mint?" ask the other plants. They don't know. Nobody does. Conceal-mint is just that sneaky.

BriefIntroduction.en: Boosts shadow plants

Introduction.en: Ail-mints poison all zombies when planted and provide a temporary boost to all Ail-mint Family plants on the lawn.

Chat.en: Ail-mint is quick to state that poison should not be taken internally. Or externally, for that matter. Really, just leave it alone. It's poison!

BriefIntroduction.en: Boosts poison plants and fungi

Introduction.en: Enchant-mints randomly hypnotize a number of zombies and provide a temporary boost to all Enchant-mint Family plants on the lawn.

Chat.en: "I just love musical theater。" says Enchant-mint. Yeah, it doesn't have much to do with magic or his abilities or strategic strengths, but it's a fact. He just likes the songs.

BriefIntroduction.en: Boosts magical plants

Introduction.en: Pepper-mints set off lane-wide bursts of flame when planted and provide a temporary boost to all Pepper-mint plants on the lawn.

Chat.en: Pepper-mint likes heat. He's down with flames, he digs on fire, he's a total madman for oxidization and ignition. If he sees you rubbing two sticks together, he'll come over and ask about it. He can't help himself.

BriefIntroduction.en: Boosts fire plants

Introduction.en: Doom Shrooms can blow up all zombies in a huge area. Leaving a crackled tile.

Chat.en: "Leave me far from what is valuable for you. How gentle I was to have told you that!"

BriefIntroduction.en: Blows up all zombies in a huge area

Introduction.en: Instant plant that crushes zombies in the lane under its girthy jellified mass. Leaves behind a pool of acidic goo that both slows and damages zombies when a zombie is crushed.

Chat.en: Cran Jelly is more than capable of changing into any other shapes. Cubes. Pyramids Cones. Icosahedron. It can do it all. But few shapes are as structurally strong or offer as much zombie crushing power as the cylinder. Not to mention, it lets him go really fast.

BriefIntroduction.en: Crushes zombies in the lane under its girthy jellified mass

Introduction.en: Baby Dragon Bruits launch explosive seed pod projectiles at zombies.

DESCRIPTION.en: powered Baby Dragon Bruits apply poison to the projectiles

Chat.en: As one of the heads from a Dragon Bruit, as mentioned, you can never find out his personality.

BriefIntroduction.en: Launches an explosive seed pod projectile at zombies

Introduction.en: Torchwoods turn peas that pass through them into fireballs that deal twice as much damage. They also deal close damage as well as lanewide flame damage on defeat.

DESCRIPTION.en: does lane wide flame damage when destroyed

Chat.en: Torchwood and Snapdragon have become fast friends. They like to hang out at either the Tiki Lounge or the Renaissance Faire.

BriefIntroduction.en: Turns peas into fireballs and does lanewide damage on defeat

Introduction.en: Jalapenos destroy an entire lane of zombies.

Chat.en: This jalapeno is one spicy character by day and The Macramé Vigilante by night. You might be wondering what his secret weapons is... it's knots.

BriefIntroduction.en: Destroys an entire lane of zombies

Introduction.en: Chilly Peppers freeze and damage an entire lane of zombies, chilling zombies in nearby lanes.

Chat.en: "Get up and freeze the day!! Chilly Pepper might look innocent and unassuming but deep down he's cold as ice. Compare him to Jalapeño and watch him EXPLODE!"

BriefIntroduction.en: Freezes and damages an entire lane of zombies

Introduction.en: Perfume-shrooms enchant dinosaurs and charm them into working against the zombies.

DESCRIPTION.en: affects all dinosaurs in a lane

Chat.en: Perfume-shroom emits a pure, concentrated mist of aerosolized love.

BriefIntroduction.en: Charms dinosaurs against zombies

Introduction.en: Puff-shrooms are short-range shooters that last for a limited time.

Chat.en: Puff-shroom is hip to all the latest social networks. He loves to surf Sporebook, FungusedIn and ShroomstaGram. But he sometimes misses the simple camaraderie of a good ol' fashioned Lawn Area Network party.

BriefIntroduction.en: Short-range shooter, lasts for a limited time

Introduction.en: Gloom Vines power individual shadow plants and shoot zombie-damaging gloom in eight directions.

Chat.en: Gloom Vine's gloomy exterior shouldn't be seen as implying a gloomy interior. His interior is gloomy, but for complicated personal reasons that go way back.

BriefIntroduction.en: Shoots in 8 directions

Introduction.en: Vamporcinis are defensive plants that drain HP from surrounding zombies for a few seconds.

DESCRIPTION.en: HP from zombies becomes her own toughness

Chat.en: "Zombie blood Is Like Pizza, in that even when It's Bad It's Good!" - Vamporcini... probably

BriefIntroduction.en: Drains HP from surrounding zombies for a few seconds

Introduction.en: Primal Potato Mines cost more than regular Potato Mines, but they arm more quickly and do damage over a larger area.

Chat.en: Primal Potato Mine doesn't consider himself to be primal. As far as he's concerned he's state-of-the-art. And who knows? Maybe he is.

BriefIntroduction.en: Explodes and does area damage

Introduction.en: Cactus fires a penetrating thorn that can damage multiple enemies! Hides underground when zombies are close. Can pop balloon zombies.

DESCRIPTION.en: hides and does ground damage when zombies are near

Chat.en: Things have really changed for Cactus lately. Book deals, movies, truck show appearances... she's just trying to focus on staying humble and launching thorns like always.

BriefIntroduction.en: Fires a penetrating thorn, hides for ground damage

Introduction.en: Power Lilies create one Plant Food out of thin air.

Chat.en: From seedling to sapling, to full grown foliage, Power Lily's experience as a life coach has shown her the best way to empower and support plants everywhere.

BriefIntroduction.en: Creates one Plant Food for use

Introduction.en: Fire Gourds charge for a while and breathes fire ahead, damage to zombies continuously and damage more to armor racks.

DESCRIPTION.en: the longer he charges, the farther he breathes

Chat.en: Fire Gourd used to be a sidekick in an acrobatic class. But since he came to fight against zombies, he's found his unique value.

BriefIntroduction.en: Tap on the gourd to breathe fire ahead

Introduction.en: Coconut Cannons fire down a single lane, causing a medium explosion on impact.

DESCRIPTION.en: on impact, explodes in medium area

Chat.en: Sure, he's a hairy old man, but Coconut Cannon can still fire on all cylinders. The reason he's so hairy: he's in-between waxings.

BriefIntroduction.en: Tap on the cannon to fire an explosive coconut

Introduction.en: Pea Pods can be planted in the same space for up to 5 times the destruction.

DESCRIPTION.en: increases rate of fire with multiple plantings

Chat.en: Having studied Quantum Spatial Mechanics in Clown College, Pea Pod has been amusing families of all ages.

BriefIntroduction.en: Plant multiple times on the same spot to multiply damage

Introduction.en: Snapdragons breathe fire that causes damage in 6 adjacent tiles.

DESCRIPTION.en: damages all zombies in the 6 tiles in front of it

Chat.en: Although the most powerful dragon in the plant kingdom, he still dreams of wings and seeing the world beneath him.

BriefIntroduction.en: Breaths fire in an area in front of it

Introduction.en: Cold Snapdragons breathe icy mist into 6 adjacent tiles that both slows and damage zombies.

DESCRIPTION.en: damages and chills all zombies in the 6 tiles in front of it

Chat.en: Cold Snapdragon gets chilly when anyone brings up his cousin Snapdragon. "We just view temperature very differently, and I'd really rather not discuss it," he says. Yikes.

BriefIntroduction.en: Breaths icy mist in an area in front of it

Introduction.en: Gatling Peas fire 4 peas at one time at a shorter shooting rate.

Chat.en: During a certain explosion at a research center, a reed was thunderstruck and became Lightning Reed. Meanwhile, a Peashooter on a gatling was also zapped, that's the origin of our new superhero, Gatling Pea.

BriefIntroduction.en: Shoots 4 peas at a time

Introduction.en: Split Peas shoot peas forward and backwards.

Chat.en: "It's my turn with the eyebrows," said Frontie. "Fine, we'll split them," said Backie. Sprouted two minutes apart, their eyebrow war is eternal.

BriefIntroduction.en: Shoots peas forward and backward

Introduction.en: Chili Beans deliver a crippling bout of gastrointestinal distress.

DESCRIPTION.en: eating zombie is destroyed and releases stunning gas

Chat.en: He's not blushing, he's trying to hold it in.

BriefIntroduction.en: Zombies that eat it are defeated and release gas

Introduction.en: Tall-nuts are heavy-duty wall plants that block low flying zombies.

Chat.en: Tall-nut is opening a chain of stores for Tall and Taller gentlemen. "I'll shell out the savings to you!"

BriefIntroduction.en: Heavy-duty wall that blocks low flying zombies

Introduction.en: Hurrikales push back all zombies in their lane with a chilling wind.

DESCRIPTION.en: blows away flying zombies in lane

Chat.en: You could say Hurrikale is a "blow hard" in the truest sense of the phrase. He is the first chair trombonist in the Biennial Philharmonic Orchestra. He is also proficient in the trumpet, saxophone and the tuba. But man o' man, you should really see him on the flugelhorn. Dude absolutely kills it.

BriefIntroduction.en: Blows a chilling wind that pushes back zombies in lane

Introduction.en: Stallias slow down zombies with a puff of perfume.

DESCRIPTION.en: single use, activates when zombie is close

Chat.en: "Life moves too quickly in our modern world," says Stallia. "Folks need to slow down and smell some spores."

BriefIntroduction.en: Slows zombies in nearby lanes

Introduction.en: Electric Peashooters fire pea-like orbs that pass through zombies and crackle with electrical power, doing damage all the while.

Chat.en: Electric Peashooter expects resistance, but he doesn't want to ohm anybody.

BriefIntroduction.en: Fires electric peas

Introduction.en: Squashes will smash the first zombie that gets close.

Chat.en: Squash is actually his stage name. His birth name was Tracy.

BriefIntroduction.en: Squashes zombies

Introduction.en: Gloom Shrooms shoot zombie-damaging gloom in eight directions. When powered and shooting, they power near by shadow plants.

DESCRIPTION.en: powers shadow plants in an area when shooting

Chat.en: Some see him as depressed, but he's got a lot of sides.

BriefIntroduction.en: Damages all zombies in a 3x3 area

Introduction.en: Magnifying Grass turns sun into a bolt of colorful damage.

DESCRIPTION.en: tap to spend sun for an attack

Chat.en: Magnifying Grass understands the inherent power of a rainbow. Beneath her stoic features she takes great joy in delivering radiant multicolored destruction to the zombie horde.

BriefIntroduction.en: Tap to spend sun for a powerful attack

Introduction.en: Celery Stalkers wait until zombies pass, then pop up and bash them from behind.

Chat.en: Celery Stalker resents the implication that there's anything unsavory about his attack style. He simply believes that discretion is the better part of vegetation.

BriefIntroduction.en: Pops up and bashes zombies from behind

Introduction.en: Sap-flings create zombie-slowing puddles of sap.

DESCRIPTION.en: does no damage on impact, but create sap puddle
slows zombies who walk in puddle

Chat.en: You've gotta see Sap-fling's throwing arm to believe it. He may be young, but everyone agrees ... the kid's got TALENT. Scouts from some of the biggest Pinecone Ball teams have been keeping a close eye on him. He could be headed to the majors. Oh sure, some knock him for his incredibly sticky spitball. But he only uses all-natural sap, so it's entirely legal.

BriefIntroduction.en: Creates zombies-slowing puddles of sap

Introduction.en: Parsnips snip at zombies, then charge down the lane at the last moment.

DESCRIPTION.en: charges down the lane when defeated and snips zombies in front

Chat.en: "Snip!" said Parsnip. "Snip snip snip! If it wasn't for my scrapbook, my coupons, and snipping zombies to death, I just don't know what I'd do with myself!"

BriefIntroduction.en: Snips zombies, than charges down lane

Introduction.en: Explode-O-Nuts provide protection, and when their shells are eaten, they explode to blow up zombies.

Chat.en: "My only regret," says Explode-O-Nut, "is that I have but one chewy center full of nitroglycerin to give in defense of this lawn."

BriefIntroduction.en: Explodes when eaten

Introduction.en: Grapeshots explode and scatter bouncing projectiles in eight directions.

Chat.en: "Spa-BOOM!" enthuses Grapeshot. "You liked that? I got a million of 'em! Wa-POW! Buh-BLAM! Za-... um... Ker-... hmmm... Okay, I guess I've only got the three."

BriefIntroduction.en: Explodes and scatters bouncing projectiles

Introduction.en: Planterns remove fogs in a small range and reveal invisible zombies.

DESCRIPTION.en: when Plant Fooded, gives each zombie 25 sun and hides nearby plants

Chat.en: Plantern does his job according to his past experience, "Why not do the same thing as what zombies did in the past?"

BriefIntroduction.en: Removes fogs and reveals invisible zombies

Introduction.en: Bulbkekengus remove fogs in a medium range.

Chat.en: Bulbkekengi soon became inseparable friends with Torchwood and Snapdragon, dubbing themselves the "Musketeers of Flame". However, the Hawaiian-themed lounge seems hesitant to serve the trio—the owner doesn't want to see any more scorched tables.

BriefIntroduction.en: Removes fogs in a medium range

Introduction.en: Heavenly Peaches heal all surrounding plants, regaining their health.

Chat.en: Her resume says that she was once a peach of Wangmu Niangniang for consumption, and became a medic after being demoted to mortal.

BriefIntroduction.en: Heals plants in a 3x3 area

Introduction.en: Jack O' Lanterns spray fire down a lane, doing extensive burning damage over a short distance.

Chat.en: "Boo! Mwah-ha-ha-haaaaah," opines Jack O' Lantern. Oh, yes. Things and stuff are scheduled to be seriously spooky when he's around. Count on it.

BriefIntroduction.en: Fires jets of flame over a short distance

Introduction.en: Pyre Vines can be planted on top of other plants to provide protection from cold plus an additional close range flame attack.

Chat.en: Pyre Vine considers his holdings, his fortune, his vast hoard of wealth. He feels it should please him, and yet nevertheless he is anxious and fearful.

BriefIntroduction.en: Warms and flames

Introduction.en: Dandelions send explosive seeds down three different lanes, one lane at a time.

DESCRIPTION.en: can attack targets in the lane above or below
may react to certain strong winds

Chat.en: "Look," says Dandelion, shaking his head, "I'm not a leprechaun and I'm not a genie. You can blow my seeds off all you want, but I can't make your wish come true. I don't even know how that rumor got started."

BriefIntroduction.en: Attacks multiple lanes, one lane at a time

Introduction.en: Chard Guards are defensive blockers that can hurl zombies backwards.

Chat.en: You might remember Chard Guard from his days in the WWF (that's World Wrestling Foliage). When he was in the ring - boy-oh-boy - he was something to behold! His moves! His style! His attitude! The crowd loved him. He was quite the star for a while there. Sure, those days are behind him. But if you watch carefully, when Chard Guard is fighting zombies, you'll see him use the wrestling move he made famous. The ol' Knock 'Em Dead maneuver - it gets 'em every time.

BriefIntroduction.en: Blocks and hurls zombies backwards

Introduction.en: When zombies eat Hypno-shrooms, they will turn around and fight for you.

DESCRIPTION.en: can't be eaten by chickens or weasels

Chat.en: Hypno-shroom has no trouble persuading zombies to fight on behalf of the plants. But he has yet to convince one to cluck like a chicken. "One day," he says. "One day."

BriefIntroduction.en: Makes a zombie fight for you

Introduction.en: Electric Currants create electrical fences between ones planted on the same row or column.

DESCRIPTION.en: knocks zombies back into other lanes when defeated

Chat.en: "Electricity is all very well and fine as a phenomenon," says Electric Currant, "but electromagnetism as a whole is where it's really at."

BriefIntroduction.en: Creates electric fences

Introduction.en: Escape Roots explode on contact, and can be swapped with other plants that are in danger.

DESCRIPTION.en: tap Escape Root and another plant to swap them

Chat.en: The other plants put on a big surprise party for Escape Root last week, but he did his thing and suddenly it was a surprise party...FOR THEM!

BriefIntroduction.en: Explodes and can be swapped with other plants

Introduction.en: Imitaters let you use two of the same plant during a level!

DESCRIPTION.en: can imitate any other non-mint plants

Chat.en: Having studied French Theater at Julienne, the Imitater went to the streets with his art, and has perfected his technique he calls "Potato stuck in a box".

BriefIntroduction.en: Lets you have two of the same plant

Introduction.en: Shadow-shrooms poison zombies who touch them, inflicting damage over time.

DESCRIPTION.en: powered Shadow-shrooms make poisoned zombies poison other zombies

Chat.en: Despite being such a poisonous and profoundly inedible fungus, Shadow-shroom is nonetheless a total cutie-pie.

BriefIntroduction.en: Poisons zombies over time

Introduction.en: Magnet-shrooms remove helmets and other metal objects from zombies.

Chat.en: Despite his unusual appearance, Magnet-shroom doesn't have a problem attracting girlfriends. But he does have a problem keeping them. It's the same thing every time. In the end, they always find him too clingy.

BriefIntroduction.en: Removes helmets and other metal objects from zombies

Introduction.en: Resistant Radish stands firm and resists the magic from Qigong Zombies and Black Holes' suction.

Chat.en: Resistant Radish has studied qigong for many years, but he only learned one thing: stasis.

BriefIntroduction.en: Stands firm and resists the magic from Qigong Zombies and Black Holes' suction

Introduction.en: E.M.Peaches explode and disable all machines in an area.

Chat.en: E.M.Peach has grown tired of people lazily calling him E.M.Pea. "There's a C and H there for a reason people! And I've got the stone to prove it!"

BriefIntroduction.en: Disables all machines in an area

Introduction.en: Citrons shoot powerful balls of plasma.

Chat.en: As the owner and primary user of "Vitamin C-U-Later" 20-hour energy shots, Citron is always on and always ready for action. "Let's make this happen!!"

BriefIntroduction.en: Shoots powerful balls of plasma

Introduction.en: Laser Beans fire down a lane, hitting all zombies ahead of it.

Chat.en: After a laser eye surgery had gone horribly right, Laser Bean gained a sense of purpose and a new-found affinity for competitive staring contests.

BriefIntroduction.en: Shoots a laser that pierces through zombies

Introduction.en: Solar Tomatoes stun zombies in a 3x3 area, causing each zombie to drop 50 sun.

Chat.en:
Solar Tomato wishes folks would just stop and enjoy the sunshine sometimes.
"Stop," she says. "Enjoy the sunshine. I said stop! Hold it right there! Don't move! I MEAN IT!!!"

BriefIntroduction.en: Stuns zombies into dropping suns

Introduction.en: Tile Turnips create a Power Tile on planting.

Chat.en: DJ Tile Turnip changed dance floors with his underground hit "Turnip the Beet." What's his latest mix? When he lays it down, you'll feel the power.

BriefIntroduction.en: Creates a Power Tile

Introduction.en: Tile Turnips create a Power Tile on planting.

Chat.en: DJ Tile Turnip changed dance floors with his underground hit "Turnip the Beet." What's his latest mix? When he lays it down, you'll feel the power.

BriefIntroduction.en: Creates a Power Tile

Chat.en: DJ Tile Turnip changed dance floors with his underground hit "Turnip the Beet." What's his latest mix? When he lays it down, you'll feel the power.

Chat.en: DJ Tile Turnip changed dance floors with his underground hit "Turnip the Beet." What's his latest mix? When he lays it down, you'll feel the power.

BriefIntroduction.en: Creates a Power Tile

Introduction.en: Infi-nuts are weaker than Wall-nuts, but they can regain health over time.

Chat.en: As a young nut, he spent way too much time standing between two mirrors and trying to look into infinity.

BriefIntroduction.en: A weaker Wall-nut that regains health over time

Introduction.en: Tile Turnips create a Power Tile on planting.

Chat.en: DJ Tile Turnip changed dance floors with his underground hit "Turnip the Beet." What's his latest mix? When he lays it down, you'll feel the power.

BriefIntroduction.en: Creates a Power Tile

Introduction.en: Marigolds give you coins over time.

DESCRIPTION.en: can be found in Zen Garden occasionally

Chat.en: Marigold used to dedicate herself to the Zen lifestyle. She was a team player, and gave it her best there in the garden. But when she heard needed to confront zombies on the lawn again, she said she'd prepared for that!

BriefIntroduction.en: Gives you coins over time

Introduction.en: Red Marigolds give you coins over time, burn when defeated.

Chat.en: Marigold used to dedicate herself to the Zen lifestyle. She was a team player, and gave it her best there in the garden. But when she heard needed to confront zombies on the lawn again, she said she'd prepared for that!

BriefIntroduction.en: Gives you coins over time

BriefIntroduction.en: Gives you coins over time

Chat.en: Marigold used to dedicate herself to the Zen lifestyle. She was a team player, and gave it her best there in the garden. But when she heard needed to confront zombies on the lawn again, she said she'd prepared for that!

Introduction.en: Pink Marigolds give you coins over time, summon random mushrooms when defeated.

Chat.en: Marigold used to dedicate herself to the Zen lifestyle. She was a team player, and gave it her best there in the garden. But when she heard needed to confront zombies on the lawn again, she said she'd prepared for that!

BriefIntroduction.en: Gives you coins over time

Introduction.en: Purple Marigolds give you coins over time, poison nearby zombies when defeated.

Chat.en: Marigold used to dedicate herself to the Zen lifestyle. She was a team player, and gave it her best there in the garden. But when she heard needed to confront zombies on the lawn again, she said she'd prepared for that!

BriefIntroduction.en: Gives you coins over time

Introduction.en: Apple Mortars lob apple cores that damage and briefly stun zombies over three lanes.

Chat.en: Apple Mortar stuns three zombies dead in their tracks. SPAF! That'll show 'em! That'll show ALL of them!

BriefIntroduction.en: Lobs stunning cores down three lanes

Introduction.en: Red Stingers fire shots at full force when close to home, and become more defensive further from it.

Chat.en: Flexibility is of key importance to Red Stinger. "I do stretching exercises every morning," he says. "It's important to stay physically and mentally nimble."

BriefIntroduction.en: Fires shots at full force when close to home and becomes more defensive further from it

Introduction.en: Skyshooters shoot peas at attacking zombies. They can be planted in the sky.

DESCRIPTION.en: could be planted in the sky

Chat.en: The youngest Peashooter ever to earn a pilot's license. Also the only Peashooter ever to earn a pilot's license.

BriefIntroduction.en: Flying shooters that shoot peas at the enemy at a higher speed

Introduction.en: Sun Beans infect zombies with sun. As a zombie takes damage it generates sun.

Chat.en: As the eldest of the four bean brothers, Sun Bean often finds his siblings exasperating. Chili Bean is a little crude, Laser Bean is too far out, and Spring Bean is just plain lazy. Still, he loves them just the same. That's how it is with family.

BriefIntroduction.en: Zombies that eat it drop suns when damaged

Introduction.en: Moon Beans turn into a sunbomb when eaten.

Chat.en: She and Sunflower are besties. It's just too bad their schedules make it hard for them to get together.

BriefIntroduction.en: Turn into a sunbomb when eaten

Introduction.en: Pea-nuts can shoot peanuts and block zombies.

Chat.en: Pea-nut knows that some folks have an aversion to him. He tries to be sensitive to their concerns and give them the space they need. Still, he can't help but miss the good old days - back when he was the most popular nut around.

BriefIntroduction.en: Shoots peanuts and blocks zombies

Introduction.en: Tangle Kelps are aquatic plants that pull the first zombie that nears them underwater.

Chat.en: Tangle Kelp likes to go deep. He majored in philosophy. Grab a root beer with him, and he'll go on and on about Nietzsche's "Thus Spoke Zucchini" or hold forth on Kant's "Critique of Petunia Reason." It's cool and all, but sometimes you just want to keep the conversation light. Sometimes you just want to talk about the temperature of the water.

BriefIntroduction.en: Aquatic plant that pulls a zombie underwater

Introduction.en: Bowling Bulbs rolls shots that can bounce into multiple zombies. The Larger bulbs deal more damage.

Chat.en: Guess which team has won the League Championship for five years running now? Team Bowling Bulb, that's who. They are on a ROLL. You and your pals think you got what it takes to stop 'em? Yeah sure. Keep dreamin, bub.

BriefIntroduction.en: Rolls bouncing shots that can hit multiple zombies

Introduction.en: Guacodiles fire seeds from a distance. When attacked they will rush off the lawn biting any zombies they encounter.

DESCRIPTION.en: plant is lost on rushing attack

Chat.en: Ask Guacodile to tell you a little bit about himself and he'll give you a wry smile. "I'm a Guacodile. I've got a bite like a bear trap. I spit rock-hard pits with a force, speed and accuracy envied by every plant on the battlefield. Heck, I've been known to walk on water. I'm pretty much the whole enchilada." Yeah, the guy is a bit of a braggart but he's good at what he does.

BriefIntroduction.en: Shoots seeds, will rush all zombies ahead of him when attacked

Introduction.en: Ghost Peppers haunt zombies that pass by and explode after a limited time.

Chat.en: You might not know it looking at her, but Ghost Pepper didn't always wear that white sheet everywhere she went. She first put it on as a lark for a Halloween party one year. Everyone else had these elaborate costumes, and she thought that it would be funny to dress like a plain ol' ghost. But she fell in love with that costume. It spoke to her. She'd found her calling.

BriefIntroduction.en: Haunts all zombies that pass by and explodes after a limited time

Introduction.en: Sweet Potatoes attract zombies from other lanes when they are close by.

Chat.en: Sweet Potato really is as sweet as she looks. Her favorite animal is the unicorn. Her favorite color is (and this is a direct quote) "all the colors in the rainbow". When she writes the letter "i", she draws a little heart where the dot belongs. Frankly, if it were anyone else, this amount of syrup would be sickening. But on her, well, it just seems right.

BriefIntroduction.en: Attracts zombies from other lanes when they are close

Introduction.en: Pepper-pults lob flaming peppers at zombies and keep nearby plants warm.

Chat.en: Some say Pepper-pult is a hot head. Some find his fiery disposition off-putting. But the truth is, he's just very focused and determined. He loves what he does. He appreciates everything he has. "I came from the weedy side of the lawn," Pepper-pult explains. "I worked hard to pull myself up by my roots. I'm a self-made pepper and I don't take a single thing for granted."

BriefIntroduction.en: Lobs flaming peppers at zombies and warms nearby plants

Introduction.en: Hot Dates attract zombies from lanes above and below them, and then unleash a lane of flame when they're eaten.

DESCRIPTION.en: unleash a lane of flame when eaten

Chat.en: Hot Date's a charmer. He's polite, well-read, has lots of interesting opinions, and practices active listening. Zombies line up around the block to be incinerated by him.

BriefIntroduction.en: Attracts and burns zombies

Introduction.en: Hot Potatoes melt the ice blocks they're planted on.

Chat.en: How does Hot Potato stay so positive and even-peeled all the time? Yoga, that's how. She never misses a class. Also, regular meditation. It's the only way she can handle the hard work of fighting zombies, day in and day out, without melting down.

BriefIntroduction.en: Plant it on an ice block to melt the block

Introduction.en: Stunions breathe a stunning cloud of gas on nearby zombies in the lane.

DESCRIPTION.en: single use, activates when zombie is close

Chat.en: Oh sure, everyone knows Stunion as the battle-hardened warrior with the potent breath. But he's so much more than that. He's an accomplished pianist. He speaks five languages fluently. Heck, he's the leader of a Cub Shallots group in his spare time. Dude's got layers. Go on, peel 'em back. You'll see.

BriefIntroduction.en: Stuns nearby zombies in the lane

Introduction.en: Gold Leaves create a Gold Tile on planting.

Chat.en: "For a small initial investment, you too can generate huge sun," says Gold Leaf. She's a firm believer in solar markets.

BriefIntroduction.en: Creates Gold Tile on planting

Introduction.en: A.K.E.E.s lob projectiles that bounce from zombie to zombie.

Chat.en: Autonomous Katapulting Ejectomatic Emitter is actively looking for a different acronym for A.K.E.E., because let's face it, "Katapulting" is just not working.

BriefIntroduction.en: Lobs projectiles that bounce from zombie to zombie

Introduction.en: Endurians are defensive plants that deal damage to zombies attacking them.

Chat.en: "When other plants talk about me, they say I'm too gruff. They say I'm difficult to approach, that I'm afraid to let others get too close to me. Also, I smell terrible," said Endurian. But deep down inside, he knows that he's so much more than that. He's also short-tempered.

BriefIntroduction.en: Blocks off zombies and protects your other plants

Introduction.en: Toadstools gulp down zombies whole, then produce sun.

Chat.en: Toadstool just can't stand being idle. "I keep everything that I want to do on lists, and keep the lists where I can see them so that I'm always motivated!" she said. Whenever there's work to be done, she's always the first to hop to it.

BriefIntroduction.en: Gulps down zombies whole, then produce sun

Introduction.en: Lava Guavas erupt, creating a lava pool that burns zombies.

DESCRIPTION.en: creates a burning lava pool in its tile

Chat.en: Lava Guava frowns with barely-repressed rage. He's trying to keep it in check. He's trying so hard. But one day some zombie's going to push him too far and he can't be held responsible for the consequences.

BriefIntroduction.en: Erupts and leaves behind a burning lava pool

Introduction.en: Phat Beets thump out damage every second.

Chat.en: Phat Beet has been known to drop sick rhymes, dope grooves, and highly satisfactory jams, often within seconds of each other.

BriefIntroduction.en: Thumps out damage every few seconds

Introduction.en: Strawburst grows a berry for small, medium or huge damage!

Chat.en: "Big is good," says Strawburst. "Though small's pretty choice as well. And you should never discount medium. I just like sizes, really."

BriefIntroduction.en: Grows a berry for small, medium or huge damage

Introduction.en: Thyme Warps rewind time, sending zombies back where they started.

Chat.en: "Possibilities other to open be to need we." Warp Thyme says, "Limited too far was time to approach unidirectional the that felt always I've."

BriefIntroduction.en: Sends zombies back where they started

Introduction.en: Sea-shrooms are short-range shooters that last for a limited time, longer in water.

Chat.en: Sea-shroom's celseliums have been carved with the feelings when he first met the ocean.

BriefIntroduction.en: Short-range shooter, lasts for a limited time but lives longer in water

Introduction.en: Garlics divert zombies into other lanes.

Chat.en: Good against zombies, as well as proof against any vampires who might accidentally wander by.

BriefIntroduction.en: Diverts zombies into other lanes

Introduction.en: Pea Commandoes deploy three flying pea soldiers to launch a heavy attack on the three leftmost zombies.

Chat.en: were among those who failed the "Air Raid" elite selection. Rather than raiding zombie bases under the cover of night like the elites, they're better suited to guard duties at their own base!

BriefIntroduction.en: Deploys flying pea soldiers to launch a heavy attack on the zombies

Introduction.en: Caulipowers use their mental powers to hypnotize random zombies and turn them against their former friends.

Chat.en: Caulipower's eyes spin with distress. He's just thought of a really great ending for his novel, but he's afraid his cousin won't understand it.

BriefIntroduction.en: Hypnotizes electrocute zombies

Introduction.en: Electric Blueberries randomly electrocute zombies every so often.

Chat.en: Electric Blueberry prides herself for being eclectic as well as electric. "I like to keep'em guessing," she says. "A zombie should always be like, 'Whoa, didn't see that coming,' when they're disintegrated."

BriefIntroduction.en: Randomly electrocute zombies

Introduction.en: Spore-shrooms fire spores that make zombies create new Spore-shrooms when defeated.

Chat.en: "My favorite arithmetic operation?" wonders Spore-shroom. "I guess I'd have to say, um, addition. Hang on, no... multiplication."

BriefIntroduction.en: Spawns new Spore-shrooms from defeated zombies

Introduction.en: Intensive Carrots bring eaten plants back to life.

Chat.en: "How do I revive defeated plants?" asks Intensive Carrot. "In a word: Vitamins. Vitamins and sorcery."

BriefIntroduction.en: Brings eaten plants back to life
